definitions.explanation: A condition where blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated, increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

examples.japanese: {高血圧|こうけつあつ}は{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: High blood pressure is one of the lifestyle diseases.

examples.japanese: {塩分|えんぶん}の{取|と}り{過|す}ぎは{高血圧|こうけつあつ}の{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: Excessive salt intake can cause high blood pressure.

examples.japanese: {高血圧|こうけつあつ}の{薬|くすり}を{毎日|まいにち}{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I take high blood pressure medication every day.

notes:
{高血圧|こうけつあつ} refers to high blood pressure (hypertension).

Related terms:
- {血圧|けつあつ} (blood pressure)
- {低血圧|ていけつあつ} (low blood pressure)
- {最高血圧|さいこうけつあつ}/{収縮期血圧|しゅうしゅくきけつあつ} (systolic pressure)
- {最低血圧|さいていけつあつ}/{拡張期血圧|かくちょうきけつあつ} (diastolic pressure)

Common expressions:
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ}の{治療|ちりょう} (treatment of hypertension)
- {血圧|けつあつ}を{測|はか}る (to measure blood pressure)
- {血圧|けつあつ}が{高|たか}い (to have high blood pressure)

Note:
{高血圧|こうけつあつ} is called "silent killer" because it often has no symptoms but increases the risk of stroke ({脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}) and heart disease ({心臓病|しんぞうびょう}). Japan has many public blood pressure monitors in pharmacies and community centers.
